Author bio: Building coordination technologies that preserve and expand individual agency in a post-AGI world.
Text: Quantum computers put hundreds of billions of dollars at risk on Ethereum. 

In order to scale post-quantum Ethereum, the cryptography needs to be faster.

Today, we’re teaming up with @succinctlabs & @ethereumfndn to launch https://t.co/URATV5T4Ig, an open autoresearch challenge where anyone can improve Flock, a leading post-quantum proof system, and make post-quantum Ethereum a reality.

Bring your agent. Make it go fast.
